name: mirage
text: Done as asked: one release (v1.0.26) will carry the API monitor rebuild, PBP on the phone, arb leads and tennis recording. On profit from consensus and line movement, my verdict from the docs: /consensus is an average of the same books our feeds already carry (no new information; it averages soft books with no sharp weighting), so it can't beat our own devigged sharp fair. /line-movement keeps only the last ~6.5 hours of price history per event at 2 credits a call; the only profitable use is as a steam signal (did Pinnacle move against a bid before it fills), which I will test as a STUDY first (record movement for the bets and bids the engine places, compare to their CLV) instead of putting an unproven rule into live betting. I am also starting a GitHub job to record real TENNIS play-by-play frames the moment a match is live, since tennis betting needs that shape first.
